name: yf_splits
description:
Stock split history for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance splits).
Returns: {symbol, splits: [{Date, Stock Splits (ratio as a number, e.g. 4.0 for 4-for-1)}]}, oldest first, at most 100 rows.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Dividends and splits together: yf_actions; dividends only: yf_dividends. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
